findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns original config, discarding schedule_type conversion
findings.body: The function copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into `config` and conditionally replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with the human-readable display value, but the returned context uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. The conversion is therefore never applied, so the produced monitor issue occurrence context will contain the raw schedule_type value rather than the display value that the code clearly intends to emit.
